Charlie: many interests still open
Charlie likes trying almost anything, from school projects to helping people and making things. None stands out reliably yet. In the creative branch Charlie selects every offered option because all sound interesting, not because each profession has distinct evidence. College, practical training and several working settings remain open; lifestyle preferences are similarly exploratory.
Fictional development case. Includes shared scripted defaults.

LIFESTYLE 1. Where would you feel at home?
Answer: My own space — A comfortable one-bedroom apartment.
Choices: Share a place — A room of your own.
